title: Implement multi-positive in-batch contrastive loss
prompt: Return multi-positive contrastive loss: negative log of summed positive probability per query. Scores/Boolean positives are [B,N], every row needs a positive, and all N candidates enter the denominator. Use logsumexp and a positive temperature.
